thread:
maya: Heads-up design review: compact rules list is nice but the 'pin' control is too subtle. New users don't realize they can force a rule to run first.

sam: Noted. Propose we add both a hover label and a persistent small badge when pinned. The badge could read 'Pinned'.

jordan: Also consider keyboard discoverability. Maybe add a context-menu action and surface the shortcut in the tooltip (e.g., Ctrl+Shift+P).

devin: The simulator control vanishes if you collapse all rules. I keep expanding to find it. Can we pin a micro-simulator in the top-right of the editor (play/pause + last run timestamp)?

aria: Accessibility: the pin is an icon button with no accessible name when list is compacted. Screen readers announce "button". We need aria-label="Pin rule" and an aria-pressed state.

maya: Good call. Also adjust focus order: tab should land on the pin before entering the rule body. That improves keyboard editing flow.

sam: Validation copy request: instead of vague "Rule conflict" show "Conflicting rules detected 12 adjust priorities or pin one rule to force order." Keep it short but actionable.

jordan: We should include a tiny inline help link next to the validation: "Learn how priority works" -> opens docs modal.

devin: Simulator behavior question: should simulation run against the unsaved draft by default? PMs expect draft-simulation while editing.

aria: I vote default to draft. Add a dropdown to run against Published snapshot explicitly. Also surface when simulation used a snapshot vs draft.

sam: Engineering caution: snapshotting drafts for simulation could be costly for very large policies. We should add a warning if rule count > 100 and optionally throttle.

maya: UX compromise: run draft by default but show a small "Saved snapshot" indicator and an opt-in toggle for heavy runs.

jordan: Visual polish: when pinned, separate pinned rules with a faint divider and keep pinned group sticky at top. Improves scan and discoverability.

aria: Contrast nit: the current pinned badge color fails AA small text. Use a darker fill or increase weight.

devin: Performance: if simulation input size > 200 rules show "estimating runtime..." and don't block main thread. Use progressive results streaming.

sam: Minor table fix: results table truncates the 'explanation' column poorly. Allow row expansion or wrap text.

maya: Action items: 1) Update prototype with hover label + badge + aria-label + focus order change. 2) Add sticky micro-simulator. 3) Update validation copy and add docs link. 4) Simulator defaults to draft + snapshot toggle + large-policy warning.

jordan: I'll push updated Figma frames with these changes and mark the components for dev handoff. ETA EOD.

design-ci-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.com/file/def456/routing-policy-editor - frames 20-25 (jordan).

maya: Can someone run a keyboard-only/a11y pass once frames are ready? Devin you good for that?

devin: Yep, I'll do a keyboard & screen-reader test tomorrow and report issues here.

sam: I'll file a small ticket for the copy + aria fixes and link it once created (will include acceptance criteria). :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team. Let's reconvene after the QA pass.
